name: Sound present
howDetected: Short-term signal energy above a silence threshold for a meaningful fraction of the segment.
limitations: Measures the file, not what reaches a listener; playback volume and room acoustics are unknown.

name: Speech present
howDetected: Heuristic acoustic classifier (syllable-rate envelope modulation, proportion of low-energy frames, spectral-flux variability, zero-crossing variability), or word timestamps from a transcript.
limitations: Heuristic, not a trained model; accuracy on real media is unvalidated. Singing, rap and speech over music are easily confused. Please correct errors.

name: Music present
howDetected: Heuristic acoustic classifier (spectral stability, sustained tonal energy, beat periodicity, few pauses).
limitations: Heuristic and unvalidated; sustained noise, ambience and some speech can be mistaken for music.

name: Possible singing / vocals with music
howDetected: Speech-like and music-like cues present in the same stretch of audio.
limitations: Low confidence: the same cues occur for speech over background music.

name: Regular beat
howDetected: Autocorrelation of an onset-strength envelope between 50 and 200 beats per minute; strength of the best peak ('pulse clarity').
limitations: Tempo estimates can be off by a factor of two; a regular beat in the signal does not guarantee a listener perceives or moves to it.

name: Large loudness change
howDetected: Difference in short-term level (dB relative to the file's full scale) within the segment or from the previous segment.
limitations: Relative level in the recording only; absolute loudness depends on playback.

name: Abrupt sound onsets
howDetected: Sharp rises in level (at least 15 dB within about 50 ms) after quieter audio.
limitations: Measures the signal; whether a person notices or is startled depends on attention, expectation and playback level.

name: Spoken words (transcript)
howDetected: Words in a user-supplied or locally generated transcript that fall inside the segment, with speaking rate in words per minute.
limitations: Transcripts can contain errors. Language processing only follows if the listener understands the language.

name: Narrative / storytelling cues
howDetected: Lexical cues: temporal connectives (then, after, when, later), past-tense narration, and references to people and places.
limitations: Simple word counting; many non-narrative passages contain these words.

name: Mental-state language
howDetected: Density of mental-state verbs (think, believe, know, want, feel, wonder, realise, remember...).
limitations: A weak cue: using these words does not mean a listener reasons about anyone's mind.

name: Laughter marker in transcript
howDetected: Transcript annotations such as [laughter], (laughs) or 'haha'.
limitations: Depends entirely on how the transcript was produced; it is a cue for a person to review possible humor, not humor itself.

name: Emotion words
howDetected: Matches against a small list of emotion words.
limitations: Word lists miss irony, context and negation; emotion words do not show what anyone feels.

name: Visual content
howDetected: Video frames present and not uniformly black.
limitations: Says nothing about where a viewer looks.

name: Visual motion
howDetected: Coarse block matching between sampled frames (about 2 per second) estimating global (camera-like) and local (object-like) motion.
limitations: Low frame sampling; cannot reliably separate camera motion, object motion and lighting change.

name: Large brightness change
howDetected: Change in mean frame brightness between sampled frames, excluding frames flagged as cuts.
limitations: Coarse; flashes shorter than the sampling interval can be missed.

name: Scene cut / shot change
howDetected: Large colour-histogram differences between consecutive sampled frames relative to the local average.
limitations: Misses dissolves and soft transitions; fast motion can cause false cuts. A cut is not necessarily a new event.

name: Faces visible
howDetected: Local face detector (TinyFaceDetector, run in your browser) on about one frame per second; fraction of sampled frames with a face and the largest face size.
limitations: Detector accuracy varies with pose, lighting, size, occlusion and demographic factors, and has not been validated for your content. It detects faces only - never identity or expressions.

name: Places / spatial layout prominent
howDetected: Marked by you (no automatic scene classifier is included).
limitations: Depends on your judgement.

name: Situation change (new time, place or action)
howDetected: Marked by you.
limitations: Depends on your judgement; viewers segment events differently.

name: Humor (interpretation)
howDetected: Marked or confirmed by you, optionally suggested by laughter markers or an optional language model.
limitations: Whether something is funny depends on the listener.

name: Suspense (interpretation)
howDetected: Marked or confirmed by you, optionally suggested by an optional language model.
limitations: Suspense depends on the viewer's understanding and investment in the story.

name: Surprise (interpretation)
howDetected: Marked or confirmed by you, optionally suggested by an optional language model.
limitations: Depends on each person's expectations.

name: Emotional theme (interpretation)
howDetected: Marked or confirmed by you, optionally suggested by emotion words or an optional language model.
limitations: Themes in content are not emotions felt by a person.
